grammar.title: Listing steps with 首先...其次...最后
grammar.pattern: 首先 + 第一点，其次 + 第二点，最后 + 第三点
grammar.explanation: This three-part sequence lays out steps clearly: 首先 (shǒuxiān) for the first point, 其次 (qícì) for the next, and 最后 (zuìhòu) for the last. It's very common in speeches, instructions, and essays.

sentences.zh: 首先介绍自己，其次说明目标，最后回答问题。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuxiān jièshào zìjǐ, qícì shuōmíng mùbiāo, zuìhòu huídá wèntí.
sentences.en: First introduce yourself, next explain your goal, and finally answer questions.

sentences.zh: 首先洗手，其次准备菜，最后开始做饭。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuxiān xǐ shǒu, qícì zhǔnbèi cài, zuìhòu kāishǐ zuò fàn.
sentences.en: First wash your hands, next prepare the food, and finally start cooking.

sentences.zh: 首先要努力，其次要坚持，最后才能成功。
sentences.pinyin: Shǒuxiān yào nǔlì, qícì yào jiānchí, zuìhòu cái néng chénggōng.
sentences.en: First you must work hard, next you must persist, and only then can you succeed.
